about_the_game:
This DLC is for players who want to support the development of Proportions.
It doesn’t provide any gameplay advantage, but unlocks exclusive cosmetic items (🎩 hats) as a thank-you to early supporters.

By purchasing this pack, you’re helping a solo developer keep improving the game ❤️
Thank you so much for your support!
